tools.name: 800.com
tools.entry_price_terms: per month on yearly billing ($23 month to month)
tools.price_note: (re-verified 2026-10-06, read on their own plans page with the full comparison open) No free tier, and the line-up is down to two self-serve plans plus Enterprise. On yearly billing: Startup $19/mo and Small Business $49/mo; month to month the same two are $23 and $59. The yearly toggle is badged 2 MONTHS FREE (it read SAVE 15% in August); on these prices the yearly rate is about 17% lower ($19 against $23, $49 against $59). Enterprise is quote-only. Startup covers 250 minutes (1,000 in our 13 August read), 1 number, 1 user, 1 extension and 120 texts, with extra minutes and texts at $0.06. Small Business covers 3 numbers (toll-free, local or vanity), unlimited users and extensions, 500 texts at $0.04 beyond that, and minutes listed as unlimited subject to the Fair Usage Policy. Extra numbers are $15 each on both plans. The older Complete plan ($99 yearly, $119 monthly in August) no longer appears, and AI Agents now sit behind a separate AI Plan whose price we could not read. Every plan carries a 30-day money-back guarantee.

tools.name: Aircall
tools.entry_price_terms: Essentials, per licence · per licence per month on annual billing ($40 billed monthly), minimum 3…
tools.price_note: (read 2026-10-10 on aircall.io/pricing in a live browser, with Aircall's own country selector on United States) Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing, which the page marks as 25% off monthly. Flip that toggle and the monthly rates read $40 and $70 per license. The discount is not uniform either: Essentials really is 25% off, but Professional lands closer to 29%, so price the plan you will actually buy rather than trusting the badge. The comparison table sets a minimum of 3 users on Essentials and Professional, so the smallest Essentials bill is $90 a month on annual billing. Enterprise is custom pricing from 25 users. Both paid plans now say they include AI Voice Agents: Essentials lists 50 min AI Voice Agents per month, and Professional is everything in Essentials plus AI call summary and conversation intelligence, smart routing, Power Dialer and outbound campaigns; on the US storefront both list unlimited calls within US & Canada. AI Voice Agents can also be bought on their own, without the phone system, at a $100 per month minimum on annual billing or $125 monthly. Minutes beyond the allowance cost $0.49 a minute pay-as-you-go, dropping to $0.39 above 2,500, or come in bundles: $175 for 500 minutes, $725 for 2,500 and $1,900 for 10,000, then about $0.19 a minute up to 35,000 ($6,650); at 54,000 minutes the calculator switches to custom pricing as low as $0.12 a minute. Add-ons, per seat a month: AI Assist Pro $49, WhatsApp $10 plus WhatsApp's own messaging rates, Analytics+ $15 and Aircall for Salesforce Voice $30. AI Messaging Agents are $0.15 to $0.35 per conversation and branded caller ID $0.08 per call, so the licence fee is a floor rather than the bill. The separate AI Assist add-on at $9 that we read on 27 September is no longer in the add-on list; the comparison table now marks call summaries, topics and call scoring as AI Assist on all three plans. The Netherlands storefront shows the same numerals in euros (EUR 30 and EUR 50), not an amount converted at the exchange rate.

tools.name: Answering Service Care
tools.entry_price_terms: Starter · billed monthly
tools.price_note: (2026-09-10, re-verified 13 October 2026 on their own pricing page, both billing toggles) Four plans, priced on included minutes. Billed monthly: Starter $40 with zero minutes included and $1.75 per minute after that; Small Business $179 for 100 minutes, then $1.70; Pro $329 for 250 minutes, then $1.60; Enterprise $639 for 500 minutes, then $1.35. Paying a year upfront takes about 10% off the monthly rate: $161, $296 and $575 for the three larger plans, while Starter stays at $40. There is also a $50 one-time start-up fee; it is still absent from the plan cards, but the page's FAQ now says plainly what it buys — customising the account, building your initial scripts and configuring routing. The plan cards no longer differ only in minutes (re-read 13 October 2026). Starter lists 24/7 cover, one phone number, call transfers, the portal and mobile app, email and SMS notifications, secure messaging, custom hold music, personalised greetings and usage reporting, with live multilingual answering shown at $1 a minute. Small Business adds one Follow Me number (valued at $15), a dedicated account manager and live chat at $5 a chat; Pro adds free call recording (valued at $10); Enterprise adds free appointment setting and one free integration (each valued at $50). The FAQ says there is no long-term contract and that you can upgrade, downgrade or cancel. The same page now also sells an AI answering line on the same minute bundles: $40 (0 minutes), $80 (100), $195 (250) and $350 (500) a month billed monthly, with AI minutes at $0.85, $0.80, $0.75 and $0.70 and live minutes at $1.75, $1.70, $1.60 and $1.60. One caution about the page itself: the explanatory text below the table still contradicts the table three times, quoting Pro at $319, Enterprise at $599 and Starter overage at $1.65. We have used the figures from the pricing table, which is the one the buttons act on.

tools.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 500 AI replies with automatic shopper-language detection…
tools.price_note: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/asknest-ai-faq-product-bot, re-verified unchanged 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-09) Four tiers, priced by AI replies per month, and the cheapest ladder in this category. Free: 50 AI replies a month, replies in one language you select, answers drawn from your FAQs, policy pages and product data, translated storefront widget, product finder and usage tracking. Starter $4.99 a month: 500 replies, automatic shopper-language detection across up to three languages, translated replies, product recommendations and best sellers. Growth $9.99 a month: 1,500 replies and all supported languages. Pro $19.99 a month: 5,000 replies. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no paid tier shows a free trial — the free plan is the trial. What the listing never says is what happens when you run out: there is no overage rate anywhere on the page, so whether reply 501 costs money or simply does not happen is not published. 'Any language' is also not on offer; customer-facing replies and widget labels cover English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Brazilian Portuguese — seven. Developer Ecommerce Storez, 1255 23rd St NW, Washington DC; the app launched 8 May 2026 and has exactly one App Store review.

tools.price_note: (verified 2026-10-16 on apps.shopify.com/ava-ai and avasales.ai) Three paid tiers, no free plan, each with a 7-day trial. Support is $29 a month and includes 100 call minutes, then $0.10 a minute; Recover is $99 a month with 400 minutes and $0.08 over; Scale is $499 a month with 1,500 minutes and $0.07 over. tools.entry_price_terms: per user a month billed annually, or $25 month-to-month

Professional (500 SMS) is where call recording, AI voicemail transcription, multilingual IVR and lifetime call logs begin. Ultimate adds smart DID, multilevel, holiday and CRM-based VIP routing with 1,000 SMS. Two different Enterprise cards sit on this page and they state different floors: the Core one a minimum of 20 users, the call-centre 'New Enterprise' a minimum of 50, both quote-only with unlimited calling to 48 countries. Hobby is $19 a month or $190 a year with a 7-day free trial: 1,000 credits, about 200 conversations, 1 agent and 10 million characters. Standard is $99 a month or $990 a year with a trial: 10,000 credits, about 2,000 conversations, 3 agents and 20 million characters. Business is $399 a month or $3,990 a year with a trial: 40,000 credits, about 8,000 conversations, 5 agents and 50 million characters. Sources are unlimited on every plan, and MCP action calls are allowed at 250, 1,250 and 5,000 a month on the plans that include them. Add-ons are $9 a month per 1,000 extra credits, $9 per 10 million training characters, $9 per extra agent and $6 per 1,000 MCP actions. Support is community on Starter and Hobby, standard on Standard and premium on Business. The terms say fees are non-refundable and payment obligations non-cancellable except as the agreement states, you can stop renewal in your account settings and keep access to the end of the period, and the agreement falls under German law with courts in Berlin.

tools.name: CometChat
tools.entry_price_terms: a month at 1,000 MAU billed yearly ($298.75 monthly)
tools.price_note: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-07 against CometChat's own machine-readable pricing reference, which they publish for AI agents and last verified themselves on 2026-05-20, and on 2026-10-07 also against the live pricing page; USD) Build is free for development: all features, up to 100 users and 25 concurrent connections, no card. Paid Chat plans are priced by monthly active users. Billed yearly, shown as a monthly equivalent: at 1,000 MAU Basic is $239 and Advanced $359; at 10,000 MAU Basic $299, Advanced $399 and Enterprise $999; at 25,000 MAU $699 and $949; at 50,000 MAU $1,349 and $1,649. Paying monthly costs 25% more — $298.75 and $448.75 at 1,000 MAU; the 'Save 20%' on the toggle is the same gap measured from the monthly price. Above 50,000 MAU everything is quote-only. Concurrency is included at 5% of your MAU on Basic and Advanced and 10% on Enterprise. On overage CometChat charges $0.10 per extra MAU (falling at higher tiers) or $1 per extra concurrent connection — and where both are exceeded it bills the higher of the two, not both.
